threshold_basis: Plugin does not clearly outperform the direct prompt overall and is not at least as good on important theme discovery.
plugin_advantages: Accepted, merged, ignored, and candidate states are preserved
Readable Obsidian wikilinks in the report
Narrative Review Report structure with activity evidence and user reflection
plugin_failures: Evidence Package omits important in-scope notes
Theme discovery is narrower than the direct prompt baseline
Benchmark state has a documented metadata/range mismatch
Report underuses merged themes and worth-rereading explanations
